newsitem.title: USA: Puerto Rican Cement projects suspended.
newsitem.headline: Puerto Rican Cement projects suspended.

text.p: Puerto Rican Cement Co said on Wednesday that development of its real estate project at Vega Alta and work at its new lime quarry at Guanica have been suspended due to permit disputes with the Puerto Rican government.
The company said it believed it applied for, obtained and received valid permits from the regulatory agencies for these operations.
"We are considering various responses to these governmental actions and we are optimistic that our position regarding these issues will prevail," Chief Executive Miguel Nazario said in statement.

Puerto Rican Cement produces cement and related products, including Portland gray cement and hydrated lime, ready-mixed concrete, multiwall paper bags, polypropylene bags, and engages in realty operations.
